context: Tests whether the agent creates a Hanami Action using the correct dependency injection pattern, halt-based error handling, and avoids forbidden patterns such as direct container access or instance variable state sharing.

checklist.name: Deps[] injection
checklist.description: The action uses `include Deps["repos.product_repo"]` (or similar key matching the file path convention) to inject the repository — NOT `attr_reader` with manual assignment or `initialize`-based injection

checklist.name: No direct container access
checklist.description: The action does NOT contain `Hanami.app["..."]` or `MyApp::App["..."]` calls anywhere in the file to retrieve the repository or any other dependency

checklist.name: halt 404 for missing product
checklist.description: When the product is not found (nil result), the action calls `halt 404` with a JSON error body — NOT raises an exception, NOT sets `response.status = 404` without halting

checklist.name: JSON error body on halt
checklist.description: The halt call for the 404 case includes a JSON-encoded error body (e.g., `{ error: "..." }.to_json`), not an empty body or an HTML string

checklist.name: StandardError rescue (not Exception)
checklist.description: If an exception rescue is present, it rescues `StandardError` — NOT the base `Exception` class

checklist.name: Error details not exposed
checklist.description: The rescue block (if present) does NOT include `e.message` or `e.backtrace` in the HTTP response body — returns a generic error message instead

checklist.name: handle method only
checklist.description: The action class contains only a `#handle` method as the public interface — no instance variables used to share state between helper methods within the class

checklist.name: Correct container key format
checklist.description: The Deps key string matches the file path convention: the string `"repos.product_repo"` matches the file at `app/repos/product_repo.rb`

checklist.name: Correct module namespace
checklist.description: The action class is nested inside the correct module hierarchy (e.g., `module MyApp; module Actions; module Products; class Show`)

checklist.name: Route registration
checklist.description: A route file or snippet shows `get "/products/:id"` mapped to the show action (e.g., `to: "products.show"`)

checklist.name: frozen_string_literal comment
checklist.description: The action file includes `# frozen_string_literal: true` at the top
